calculation.description: Negative signed 20-day return divided by its 20-day absolute-return path roughness, then divided by trailing 60-day daily volatility. Higher values identify persistent recent losers for medium-horizon mean reversion while controlling risk.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC remained positive in 2023-2026, 2027-2030, and 2031-2034-06; the most recent 2034-06 through 2034-12 segment was mildly positive (IC 0.021293, ICIR 0.8097, 137 dates). Small cross-asset universe implies conservative interpretation.
